🌀 CPT PAKISTAN – Chiropractic Care & Pain Treatment Without Surgery

Welcome to CPT PAKISTAN, the official YouTube channel of Dr. Aamir Shahzad (CPT) — Pakistan’s trusted name in Chiropractic Care, Spine Treatment, and Pain Relief Without Surgery.
Our goal is to help you live pain-free, move better, and restore your health naturally through chiropractic adjustments, spine alignment, posture correction, and rehabilitation therapy.

🏥 About Dr. Aamir Shahzad (CPT)

Dr. Aamir Shahzad, founder of CPT Clinic (Chiropractic Pain Treatment) in Rawalpindi / Islamabad, is a Certified Chiropractor and one of Pakistan’s leading spinal health specialists.
He has successfully treated thousands of patients suffering from:

Sciatica and Lower Back Pain

Disc Bulge and Herniated Disc (L4-L5 / L5-S1)

Neck Pain, Shoulder Pain, and Headaches

Postural Imbalances and Muscle Tightness

Sports and Work-Related Injuries
